cases.note: Windows OCR reads the name as 瓦奮護甲鍛造師的灌注器 -- one character wrong, 奮 for 爾 -- and an exact match against a closed lexicon has nowhere to go from there. The same currency in the right-hand slot reads correctly, so this is the recogniser and not the frame. The ONNX rescoring that exists for precisely this case does not rescue it; see the task.
